items.text: Every active ledger task binds at least one known REQ id and names a verification command; every excluded task is explicitly owner-deferred
Dependencies form a DAG; shared interfaces are frozen as level-0 tasks before dependents parallelize
High-risk work sits early in the order (fail fast), and every task has a risk class
Each task is written as a self-contained context pack: task, relevant files, pattern to follow, constraint, acceptance criteria
tasks.json projection committed; v4 trace check passes (no uncovered requirements)

redFlags: A task whose acceptance criteria need more than 3 bullets (split it)
A parallel marker on tasks that share files or runtime resources

rationalizations.excuse: Planning is slowing us down, the tasks are obvious
rationalizations.reality: Implementation without a plan is just typing. Written tasks survive session boundaries and context compaction.
